method: Complete named explanatory fields from the exact subject/pointer. Original summaries, subjects and historical reviews unchanged. This is an excerpt, not a standalone replacement contract or review.

summary.answer: Constructs reinsertion count/remaining-insertion text, collapse/wave timers, icons and redeployment child. Nonnil passenger count becomes text; reinsertion index callback computes collapse/count string, and collapseCount updates re-read that model. Timer callbacks call setupEndTimer with supplied nonnil deadlines. VisiblePandemic adds exact pandemic mode, VisibleWave adds wave-respawn setting, VisibleHotPursuit adds deposit mode, generic Visible requires remaining insertions; all retain show flag and literal HUD visibility conjunction. RedeployUnavailable requires no remaining insertions, show flag, HUD gates and collapseCount!=0. Subscriptions request state checks. Registers close, optional postload, returns self. HMH mode/settings/enum selection and real reinsertion/clock behavior remain conditional; named other-mode states are not global exclusions.
unknowns: Per-body nil/error/return/lifetime limits are explicit in ordered operations; no universal cleanup, cancellation or exception recovery is inferred.
Recovered-source fidelity defects remain visible; saved AST/receipt checks are not independent correctness review.

summary.answer: Constructs CoD.WarzoneRedeployment.new from its exact supplied layout/controller/menu arguments; creates/attaches blur, bg, led, border, Message. calls PostLoadFunc only if truthy; returns self only at the displayed return. Callback/state/clip bodies are deferred, and the exact source effects below define their receiver, data and branch contracts.
unknowns: Exact original PS4/source version matching, recovered Lua/VM fidelity and global/native/LUI provider identity remain unverified.
Model/storage/DDL/assets/localization/dvar/enum values, callback delivery/cancellation/error behavior, native networking and unavailable service/server code are separate inputs.
Other-file locals are not providers by spelling. Exact qualified global declarations are source candidates until loader/table identity and caller conditions bind them.
No implicit nil/type checks, exception recovery, timer/model disposal, idempotence or guarantee that later effects run after an error is added.
